full_judgment: 2. The facts leading to the issuance of the Rule, in short, is that the present petitioner Mosammat Afroza Banu as plaintiff filed a suit for specific performance of contract in the Court of Joint District Judge, Naogaon averring, inter-alia, that that the defendant. nos.1-6 had entered into an agreement to sell '161/2 acres of land appertaining to sabek plot no.190 of khatian no.21 corresponding to that khatian no.77 of mouza Chalk Pathoria under Naogaon Police Station and though the principal defendant nos.1-6 did not make their appearance in the suit but the added defendant nos.7-8 appearing in the suit had filed written statements and contested the suit and both the parties adduced witnesses in support of their respective pleadings and when the suit was fixed for further peremptory hearing on 30.10.2013 the plaintiff filed a petition for amendment of the plaint asserting the story as to how the defendants nos.1-6 had got the land in question from Bali Bibi and as to how she got the same from Sheikh Lal Sardcr on 09.07.1966 and the trial Court though by his order dated 30.10.2013 allowed the said petition for amendment of the plaint but the added defendant nos.7-8 as against the said order preferred a revision in the Court of District Judge, Naogaon being C.R no.75 of 2013 and the revision was ultimately heard by the Additional District Judge, Court, Naogaon who by his impugned judgment and order dated 26.02.2014 allowed the revision holding that the amendment was sought for at a very belated stage and the same will change the nature and character of the suit.
